reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 12 points better, in a game of about 244 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Bulls.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Nuggets (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 217 and 266 total points.
